text:
luca.design: dropped a lightweight frame for the SLO preview sandbox. main issue: the routing chip and the suppress toggle look like the same affordance when you skim a long rule list. frame: https://img.redwood.local/frames/sandbox_preview_v1.png
fergus.pm: noticed that too. users hit the wrong control during quick edits. suggestion: differentiate by shape + micro-icon: route = rounded filled chip with arrow icon, suppress = pill with subtle left stripe + speaker-off icon.
ravi.eng: shape + icon works. prefer the left stripe instead of full outline for dense layoutsit uses less horizontal space. also we should emit a stable aria-label on each chip: e.g., "Route to #alerts (select)" / "Quiet window (2h) (toggle)" so screen readers read intent.
megan.sre: keyboard flow note: chips currently are not in a linear tab order. Tab jumps the whole preview. Let's make each chip a focusable control with role=button and implement roving tabindex so arrow keys move between chips. Also ensure pressing Space toggles suppress.
cleo.content: microcopy tweaks: swap "Suppression" -> "Quiet window" in the UI and banner. Shorter pill label: "Quiet" looks odd; let's keep "Quiet window" but allow it to truncate to "Quiet" on very narrow widths with full tooltip. Tooltip copy: "Silences alerts for 2 hours." For routing: pill text "Route to" and tooltip "Routes alerts to selected channel(s)".
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: non-color indicators (icon/stripe), roving tabindex, role=button on chips, aria-labels with action hints, aria-live=polite for the sandbox banner, and prefers-reduced-motion respected for chip expand/collapse. Avoid aria-live=assertive.
luca.design: layout edge: in the sandbox, we show a live merged preview of thresholds + quiet windows + routing. When all three change quickly the banner pulses and currently steals focus. Proposal: keep focus stable and animate only the inner text (fade 100ms), and update an offscreen live region for screen readers after a 300ms debounce.
ravi.eng: backend note: we'll add preview_token to merged-preview responses so frontend can check if the update is new vs a quick intermediate update. Also we'll include preview_summary short text for aria-live. Example: { preview_token: "abc123", summary: "Quiet window on 1 muted for 2h; routes to #alerts" } (frontend: set innerText, not replace node).
megan.sre: QA tests: rapid edits simulation should assert only one polite announcement per pause, and keyboard test should validate Tab -> chips -> Space toggles -> Arrow keys move between chips. Add a test for truncated labels on 320px and tooltip accessibility.
cleo.content: empty state rewrite proposal: "No thresholds yet 1 Add one to start receiving alerts." CTA text: "Add threshold". Small helper link: "Choosing thresholds" -> docs.
fergus.pm: product note: add an inline "Undo" on the sandbox banner for quick reversals after toggling quiet window. Must be reachable by keyboard and announce its presence to screen readers.
a11y-bot: recommendation: Undo button aria-label "Undo quiet window" and place it inside the stable banner container. Banner should have role=status + aria-live=polite and only update after debounce. Also ensure 3:1 contrast for stripe + icon.
luca.design: great. I'll update the frame with left stripe suppress chip, icons, stable banner id, preview_token usage, and compact breadcrumb so preview stays above the fold on small laptops. Will post new frame and color-blind variants shortly. Tagging @ravi.eng @megan.sre for follow-ups.
megan.sre: I'll add the acceptance items to the QA plan.
fergus.pm: thanks everyone  will coordinate the docs and product notes. :white_check_mark:
